# luxi_go2 Packages

These packages are the custom platform layer built on top of the third-party GO2 simulation stack.

- `luxi_go2_interfaces`: custom messages, services, and actions
- `luxi_go2_bringup`: shared launch composition
- `luxi_go2_sim`: simulation extensions and worlds
- `luxi_go2_description`: custom robot description overlays
- `luxi_go2_control`: higher-level control modules
- `luxi_go2_perception`: lidar and perception processing
- `luxi_go2_localization`: odometry and localization
- `luxi_go2_slam`: mapping pipelines
- `luxi_go2_navigation`: navigation stack integration
- `luxi_go2_utils`: common utilities
